offering_description.value: Sells IP communications software and hardware for telecom carriers, cloud providers and large enterprises, including session border controllers, cloud security, unified communications and network analytics. Delivers them as on-premises appliances, virtualized software and cloud services, with maintenance and professional services.

primary_products.value: session border controllers; cloud security software; unified communications software; network analytics; voice gateways

primary_services.value: maintenance and support; professional services; managed services; cloud hosting

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecom service providers, cloud communications providers, large enterprises, critical infrastructure operators; B2G: government agencies and public safety networks

end_markets.value: telecommunications; cloud communications; enterprise IT; government; critical infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: hardware appliances and perpetual software licenses sold to carriers and enterprises; subscription: recurring software and cloud service subscriptions; service fees: maintenance, support, installation and professional services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds its own communications hardware appliances, sold to carriers and enterprises; software / platform: develops communications and security software sold to service providers and enterprises; service provider: operates managed and cloud services for customers' communications networks
